hero.title: Full-Stack & Backend
hero.subtitle: I design distributed architectures, microservices, and multi-agent systems built to last.

about.intro: Passionate about backend development and systems running behind the scenes, I turn complex problems into robust digital products. My playground: distributed architectures, automation, and intelligent agents.

projects.subtitle: Each realization is a case study: context, architecture choices, and concrete impact.

real_estate.title: Real Estate Management & Sales System (PFE)
real_estate.description: Complete real estate ecosystem connecting APIs, web, desktop, and mobile in a single business flow.
real_estate.details: A comprehensive enterprise ecosystem designed to streamline property listings, client matching, and sales contract workflows. Features real-time state synchronization between mobile agents and central administrators.
features: Real-time notification system using SignalR for instant message passing
Integrated offline syncing for field agents using SQLite and Flutter local cache
Advanced analytical dashboards with automated revenue projections in desktop client
Secure document hosting and digital signing APIs

erp_pos.title: Bariket Restaurant Website & POS
erp_pos.description: A modern, highly performant web application and POS system for Bariket Restaurant, optimized for instant food orders and queue monitoring.
erp_pos.details: A production-grade restaurant platform hosting a client website and a micro-POS management panel. Features a fast menus loading speed and an integrated ingredients inventory manager.
features: Fully responsive consumer menu client with lightning-fast static delivery
High performance caching with Redis for order queue status
Interactive sales statistics dashboard and invoicing tools
Cloud integration with Cloudflare Workers for optimal global latency

dzstock.title: DzStock ERP
dzstock.description: Stock ERP designed for complex business rules and reliable daily operations.
dzstock.details: A reliable desktop enterprise solution built for stock management, suppliers accounting, and billing systems in compliance with regional tax calculations.
features: Optimized index architectures supporting rapid inventory lookups on 100k+ SKUs
Advanced PL/pgSQL database triggers automation for auditing and double-entry bookkeeping
Interactive accounting reports generation (PDF/Excel exports)
Secure user privilege scopes using role-based access control (RBAC)

microservices.title: Distributed Real Estate Platform
microservices.description: Decoupled services for a secure, scalable, and ready-to-grow real estate platform.
microservices.details: A microservices architecture leveraging REST APIs, independent DB schemas per service, and unified authentication gateways for secure modular scaling.
features: Service containerization and deployment pipelines powered by Docker
High reliability API gateway managing request routing and rate limiting
Distributed identity tracking using custom JSON Web Token scopes
Asynchronous inter-service communications using messaging events

multi_agents.title: Multi-Agent Systems
multi_agents.description: Coordination of autonomous agents for negotiation and distributed task resolution.
multi_agents.details: R&D simulation testing distributed system orchestration through autonomous smart agents negotiative bidding.
features: Implements standard FIPA-ACL protocols over the JADE runtime
Distributed resource allocation utilizing the Contract Net protocol
Smart heuristic agents for dynamic price negotiation scenarios
Visual agent coordination tracking topology dashboard

hospital.title: Hospital Management
hospital.description: Business application structured around data reliability and operational pathways.
hospital.details: A desktop software suite managing patient record entries, consultation appointments, and doctor schedules securely.
features: Medical database designed with third-normal form normalization schemas
Custom schedule planner tool with conflict detection rules
Audit logs logging patient history modifications
Encrypted database backup automation

car_agency.title: Car Rental Agency
car_agency.description: Business management solution with a desktop interface oriented towards efficiency.
car_agency.details: A management system optimizing vehicle bookings, rental contracts, and fleet maintenance planning.
features: Interactive booking calendar tracking car status
Dynamic contract pricing based on booking parameters
Fleet checkup reminders and records dashboard
Customer billing and history tracing

bel_djazair.title: Bel Djazair
bel_djazair.description: Modern, responsive, and editorial web experience for tourist discovery.
bel_djazair.details: A beautiful web application showcasing natural sites, traditional Algerian arts, and itineraries with rich visuals.
features: Highly performant visual layout with responsive Tailwind utility patterns
Dynamic destination discovery mapping and route routing
Lightweight responsive asset serving optimized for mobile devices
Dynamic user reviews and stars feedback system
